messages.subject: help: Zero-truncated binomial in BUGS/JAGS?
parts:
hi all,
 
 we've had trouble getting a ZTbinomial working in JAGS using the ones or zeros trick. Does anyone have experience with this?
thanks!

messages.author: 403be63af7ebf220
messages.subject: Re: help: Zero-truncated binomial in BUGS/JAGS?
parts:
Have you tried using the T() operator in JAGS? Something like this might work:

x ~ dbin(p, N)T(1,)

which is different than what WinBUGS does with: 

x ~ dbin(p, N)I(1,)

 we've had trouble getting a ZTbinomial working in JAGS using the ones or zeros trick. Does anyone have experience with this?
thanks!
